text: [L384-L463,L465-L544] (HIGH/vector bounds and undefined tail) The vector readers never require 0<=vlength<=tlength, directly section value_vec(1:vlength), and leave result elements vlength+1:tlength undefined.

[L603-L643] (MED/stale file cache) The parameter cache is invalidated only when the filename string changes, so rereading a modified file under the same name returns stale values and stale used-key tracking.

[L762-L804] (HIGH/undefined optional MPI output) parmapply assigns optional parm_str only on xmaster and never broadcasts it, so a present parm_str is undefined on non-master ranks even when parameter broadcasting is enabled.
[L762-L778] (MED/unchecked default index) parmapply indexes allowednames(idefname) without checking idefname against 1:numallowednames.
[L1136-L1148] (LOW/input corruption) strippedline replaces every byte outside printable 7-bit ASCII with a blank, silently corrupting valid non-ASCII parameter values and filenames.
[L12-L15,L26-L47] (MED/empty-array bounds) linear_interp_2d does not require nx and ny to be positive before applying reductions and using the resulting indices to access X, Y, and Z.

[L1418-L1434] (MED/invalid allocation / bounds contract) trapezoidal_cyclic reads x(2), divides by dx, and indexes xp(1) and xp(np) without guarding n<2, zero spacing, reversed limits, or a resulting nonpositive np.

[L363-L406] (HIGH/duplicate schedule deadlock) For duplicate scheduled times, each output counter advances only once while tnext excludes all times equal to the current time, leaving the counter pinned on the duplicate and preventing that output category from matching later times.
[L440,L456-L458,L681-L683] (LOW/undefined optional outputs) compute_dt returns before assigning present ierr or limtypeout when xcompute is false.

[L462-L469] (MED/zero-depth division) The cold-start timestep divides by sqrt(maxval(hh)*g) without a positive lower bound, despite the branch comment explicitly anticipating zero initialization, so an all-zero depth field yields an infinite or invalid timestep.

[L488-L523,L541-L574] (MED/unchecked numerical domain) Several active stability expressions take square roots of hu/hv and divide by spacing-derived sums without guarding negative depths or zero cell metrics, allowing NaN or zero-division results to contaminate timestep selection.
[L595-L629] (MED/unchecked permeability division) Groundwater stability calculations divide directly by par%kx and par%ky without local positivity checks when their respective branches are enabled.

[L632-L647] (MED/serial/MPI behavior inconsistency) The MPI path skips angular wave limiting when ntheta<=1, whereas the serial path applies it for every nonstationary model, potentially forcing a zero or spurious dt from a meaningless dtheta in the single-direction case.
[L708-L710] (LOW/undefined optional output) timestep itself returns before defining a present INTENT(OUT) ierr when xcompute is false.

[L51-L52] (HIGH/uninitialized cache flags) The collected and precollected flags have no default initialization in the type definition even though collection logic reads collected(index) to decide whether to skip work.
[L242-L249,L395-L410,L1464-L1482] (MED/unchecked grid extent and metric) Boundary copies assume nx>=1 and slope calculations divide by dsu/dnv without checking positive nonzero grid metrics.
[L619-L623] (MED/period division) Wave intrinsic frequency is computed as 2*pi/Trep without a local positive-period guard for boundary types that do not force Trep to 10.

[L1011-L1012,L1037-L1056] (HIGH/hotstart state destruction) Although hotstart zs, uu, and vv are deliberately preserved during allocation and initial zeroing, flow_init later unconditionally resets uu and vv and all derived flow quantities to zero, discarding the loaded hotstart velocities.

[L1332-L1341,L1384-L1387] (MED/layer-index bounds) Sediment layer assignments use nd_var and, in the single-grain case, forcibly set nd_var=2 without ensuring nd is at least two or that nd_var lies within 1:nd.

[L163-L176,L227-L246] (MED/uninitialized dispatch state) checkbcfilelength does not assign filetype for wbctype values outside its enumerated branches, yet immediately selects on filetype, whose dummy argument has no declared intent or local default.

[L197-L224] (MED/empty-list validation gap) A LOCLIST file containing only its header produces nlocs=0 and skips all boundary-duration validation, allowing a positive-duration simulation to pass this check without any boundary file.

[L1175-L1253,L1402-L1419] (MED/minimum-grid bounds) gridprops assumes nx>=1 throughout and requires nx>=2 to define alfaz from an interior point; with nx=1 its two boundary-copy assignments merely circulate an uninitialized orientation.

[L145-L167,L301-L315] (HIGH/parameter-order defect) The XBeach grid branch decides whether a depth file is required from par%hotstart before the hotstart parameter is read from params.txt, so a requested hotstart can follow stale/default state and unnecessarily require or load depfile.

[L170-L175,L247-L266,L283-L296,L419-L434] (HIGH/advisory-only critical bounds) Critical positive quantities including dx, dy, dtheta, dtheta_s, tstop, gravity, and wave periods are read without strict=.true., so zero or negative out-of-range values only warn and can later drive divisions, invalid extents, or nonterminating angle normalization.

[L193-L237] (MED/unchecked external grid dimensions) Delft3D mmax and nmax are converted directly to nx=mmax-1 and ny=nmax-1 without validating minimum or maximum grid sizes before downstream allocation and boundary indexing.

[L1227-L1248] (HIGH/zero output interval accepted) tint, tintg, tintp, tintm, and tinth use strict lower bounds of zero, allowing zero intervals that timestep_init later uses as divisors when generating schedules.

[L1536-L1538] (LOW/nonlinear option coercion) Every posdwn value below 0.1, including allowed small positive values, is coerced to -1 while other positive magnitudes remain unnormalized, making this nominal sign option behave discontinuously.
